title: Indoor
subtitle: Indoor = located, happening, or intended for use inside a building rather than outdoors。 但
description: Indoor = located, happening, or intended for use inside a building rather than outdoors。 但相關替代表達會區分 inside location, building boundaries, roof cover, interior design, technical in-building systems, enclosure, and weather shelter。

falseSynonyms.zh: 內部的 ≠ all indoor internal 常指某物內部、機構內部或系統內部，不等於所有室內語境。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Internal is broader and more structural/organisational.

falseSynonyms.zh: 不是所有 indoor 搭配都能直接改寫 inside seating 很自然，但 inside sports 不自然。
有上蓋 ≠ fully indoor covered area 可以四周開放。
封閉 ≠ indoor enclosed 強調圍合，不一定等於一般室內活動空間。
有遮蔽 ≠ indoor sheltered 可是戶外但避風雨。
家居的 ≠ indoor domestic 指家庭／本地／家用，不表示『室內』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Domestic is not location-focused.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只在建築／設計內部 sense 接近 interior 不適合 indoor sport / indoor activity 等搭配。
詞性陷阱 indoor 通常是形容詞；indoors 是副詞：indoor pool / stay indoors。
